description: This file defines a Java class 'LoanRepaymentChargebackCommandHandler' which handles chargeback commands for loans in the Fineract loan application. It processes loan transaction chargebacks via the LoanWritePlatformService.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentChargebackCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that processes chargeback commands for loans, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the chargeback command by invoking the loan write platform service to process the chargeback transaction.
